rubrics.justification: Describes an expanded blastocyst with thinned zona, compact ICM, and cohesive TE consistent with the reported 3AA; appropriately notes limits of a single static image. Slight overreach in asserting details not independently verifiable from one frame.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, day-5 development, endometrial thickness, BMI, semen parameters, prior cycle history, and lifestyle factors into prognosis and transfer planning.

Overall logic is clear and conclusions generally follow from embryo quality and patient factors. Minor issues include somewhat overstating the impact of stress/alcohol and a few speculative modifiers.

Recommendations are largely consistent with IVF practice: favorable prognosis for a good-quality day-5 blastocyst, preference for single embryo transfer, optional PGT-A at age 34, and appropriate workup only after repeated failure. Small deviations include overemphasis on some lifestyle factors and optional testing.

Provides clear next steps for the current transfer and sensible future-cycle planning, including SET, luteal support adherence, activity guidance, uterine cavity review if indicated, and escalation pathways after failure.
